subject.title: fix embedded compaction hook reset API

question: Should successful `after_compaction` plugin hooks gain a permanent core `ctx.api.resetSession(reason?)` contract, with the API omitted for model-selection-locked sessions?
rationale: This creates a new session-mutating plugin capability and policy boundary; code review can assess the implementation but cannot decide whether this should become a supported external contract or whether a declarative hook result is preferred.

options.title: Sponsor the narrow API
options.body: Approve the current-session-only deferred capability, require public SDK/docs contract coverage, define locked-session behavior, and obtain live lifecycle proof before merge.

options.title: Use a declarative result
options.body: Have `after_compaction` return a typed reset request that the lifecycle owner aggregates and executes instead of exposing an imperative context API.

options.title: Keep hooks observational
options.body: Decline a core reset contract and require memory or compaction plugins to use another maintainer-approved lifecycle surface.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the narrow API
recommendation.body: Approve the current-session-only deferred capability, require public SDK/docs contract coverage, define locked-session behavior, and obtain live lifecycle proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history most strongly connects this person to both embedded compaction ownership and native Codex hook parity.
